text:
Workspace capability assessment

Installed: No capabilities can be verified as installed.
Needs configuration or approval: No capabilities can be reliably classified without configuration and access-policy data.
Unavailable: No capabilities can be verified as unavailable.

Required information: Please provide the platform name and a workspace capability, integration, permissions, or configuration inventory. Read-only screenshots or exported settings would also suffice.
limitations: The workspace metadata identifies a project but does not expose its platform features, tools, integrations, permissions, or approval rules.
No external or live workspace access is available.
